Nate said he would like to make coconut milk ice cream again and try different flavors and toppings.
Nate said he loves coconut milk and enjoys chocolate and mixed berry flavors, including in dairy-free desserts.

Joanna told Nate that she thought his cooking skills were awesome and that his food creations sounded yummy.

On 2022-02-07, Joanna asked Nate whether he had seen any good movies lately. Nate replied that he had not watched any recently and asked Joanna for recommendations; no recommendations are included in this segment.

Joanna enjoys giving movie recommendations and recommended “Little Women” to Nate on 2022-02-07.
Nate said he would add “Little Women” to his movie watch list and tell Joanna what he thought after watching it; Joanna asked him to let her know.

On 2022-02-25, Joanna said she cannot have dairy, so she cannot eat regular ice cream.

Nate enjoys making and baking desserts, and Joanna praised his cooking and dessert creations.
On 2022-02-25, while waiting to hear how her first screenplay did at a film festival, Joanna said she had started writing another screenplay because she could not stop thinking about the first one.
On 2022-02-25, Nate empathized with Joanna about how challenging it was to take her mind off waiting for news about her first screenplay and asked what her new screenplay was about.
On 2022-02-25, Joanna described a screenplay she was writing about a 30-year-old woman who takes a road trip to heal and grow after a loss while trying to discover who she is.
Joanna said her new screenplay was inspired by her personal experiences and her own journey of self-discovery; she described the story as her own story and said it deals with loss and identity.
Nate said he was excited to see Joanna's new screenplay come together and appreciated stories that tackle important issues.

As of 2022-02-25, Joanna hoped her first screenplay, which she had submitted to a film festival, would be noticed and adapted for the screen; Nate wished her luck and hoped it would find a fan and receive due recognition.

On 2022-03-18, Joanna told Nate that she had finished her second script. She described feeling relieved at times and anxious at others, with a mix of excitement and terror about her work being noticed and reaching the big screen.
On 2022-03-18, Joanna said she had been decompressing after finishing her second script but found it hard to switch off, feeling a tug-of-war between hope and doubt.
On 2022-03-18, Nate congratulated Joanna on completing her second script, praised her hard work and dedication, and encouraged her to relax and believe in herself despite her doubts.
On 2022-03-18, Nate shared a photo depicting two tortoises lying on the ground in a jungle. Nate said that walking them reminded him to enjoy the small things.
On 2022-03-18, Nate said he is drawn to turtles because they are unique, move at a slower pace than the rush of life, require little maintenance, and are calming.
On 2022-03-18, Nate shared a photo showing three turtles sitting on rocks in a pond.
Nate said turtle care involves keeping their area clean, feeding them properly, and ensuring they get enough light; he finds caring for turtles fun.
On 2022-03-18, Joanna said turtles in Nate's photo looked peaceful and remarked that pets can bring calm and joy. She described having pets as a wonderful experience.

On 2022-03-18, Joanna said she was allergic to turtles and had recently discovered she was also allergic to cockroaches. She said she would get two turtles if she were not allergic and wondered whether she would ever be able to have a pet.
On 2022-03-18, Nate offered to send Joanna photos of his turtles so she could watch them grow without getting too close.
On 2022-03-18, Joanna said she was already really invested in Nate's turtles.
On 2022-03-18, Nate asked Joanna about next steps for her screenplay and whether she had any ideas; no response to that question appears in this segment.
On 2022-03-18, Joanna said she had been researching and networking nonstop for an unspecified goal or project. She described the effort as tough but said she was determined to make it happen.

On 2022-03-18, Nate encouraged Joanna to keep working, said her idea should attract more attention, and told her not to quit because he believed a path forward would appear. Joanna thanked Nate and said his support motivated her to keep pushing forward. Nate told Joanna he was there for her.
On 2022-03-18, Joanna shared a photo depicting a cinema ticket on a chair and said goodbye to Nate. The photo does not establish whether she attended or planned to attend a movie.
On 2022-03-23, Joanna had an audition for a writing gig. Joanna said it went alright and she felt both excited and somewhat anxious about the outcome; she asked Nate to keep his fingers crossed.
Nate encouraged Joanna about her writing-gig audition, expressed faith in her, and asked her to keep him updated. Joanna said Nate’s support meant a lot and promised to update him.

On 2022-03-24, Nate was participating in a video game tournament again. He described it as intense, with a lot of adrenaline; Joanna wished him luck and remarked that several days of intense gaming sounded difficult.
On 2022-03-24, Joanna shared a photo of her go-to place for writing inspiration: a bookshelf filled with books and magazines. She said the place helps her stay sharp and motivated.

Joanna advised Nate, who asked for advice about pursuing writing, to read widely across genres, build a strong understanding of literature, write and share his work even with friends, practice and gather feedback, believe in himself, and keep following his writing dreams despite the difficulty.

On 2022-03-24, Nate said he would keep working hard on pursuing writing and see what happens. Nate wished Joanna luck with her project and said he was sure it would turn out great; they mutually encouraged each other to work hard toward their dreams.
Between 2022-04-08 and 2022-04-14, Nate dyed his hair purple. On 2022-04-15, Nate shared a selfie photo showing a man with purple hair and glasses and said he was excited about the change.
Nate chose bright, bold purple hair because he considers himself bright and bold and wanted to stand out from regular options.
Joanna told Nate that his new hair color looked amazing and said his boldness inspired her.

As of 2022-04-15, Joanna had no vacation planned because her writing was consuming her, and she was hoping for good news soon. Nate said large projects can be taxing, asked her to keep him updated, and Joanna said his support meant a lot and agreed to update him.
On 2022-04-15, Nate and Joanna ended their conversation warmly; Nate asked whether they would see each other soon, Joanna agreed, and they said goodbye.

Nate said spending time with his pets and engaging in hobbies help him take a break from reality. Joanna agreed that taking time for pets and doing activities one loves are precious ways to enjoy life and find peace.

Nate said he enjoys watching his turtles play and appreciating peaceful moments. He sometimes brings the turtles into the kitchen so they can watch him make food.

Joanna said acting was her first passion, but she now shines in writing and uses writing to express herself in a new way. She intends to keep writing, though she may return to acting someday if she feels drawn to it.
Joanna enjoys dramas and emotionally driven films, which she said spark her writing.

Joanna said that the sounds and natural beauty at Whispering Falls made her feel calm and peaceful; everything else faded away and she focused on the present. Joanna's third writing project is a personal story about loss, identity, and connection. She had held onto the story for a long time before finding the courage to write it; writing it was difficult, and she felt proud of completing it.

Joanna likes writing about sadness and loss. She believes meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings, and says she writes best when she is true to herself, even when exploring vulnerable topics is scary or difficult.

On 2022-05-20, Nate praised Joanna's courage and writing, expressed pride in her for staying strong and being true to herself, and encouraged her to continue pursuing her dreams. Joanna said Nate's support meant a lot and that having people cheering her on made her journey easier.
On 2022-05-25, Nate took his dog Max for a walk and met a friendly couple who live nearby and also have a dog.
On 2022-05-25, Nate and a nearby couple agreed to arrange dog playdates so their dogs could spend time together; Nate expected Max to enjoy having a walking buddy.
Nate said that he and the couple he met shared little in common apart from loving animals, but he felt that shared interest was enough to become good friends.
Nate enjoys watching Max play with another dog and described seeing Max so happy as a dream come true.
Joanna said that meeting people through a walk and connecting with other pet owners can be uplifting and rewarding; she encouraged Nate to keep it up.

Nate said the stuffed animal was meant to remind Joanna of good vibes and described it as joy in his pocket; looking at it makes Nate grin. Nate encouraged Joanna, telling her that rejection did not mean she lacked talent and urging her not to give up on her dreams. Joanna said she would not let the rejection bring her down and appreciated Nate’s support.

Joanna congratulated Nate and said it was great to hear about his tournaments over the years.

The new acquaintances asked Nate for tips to improve their game, and Nate offered to help because he likes helping people. Joanna praised Nate for helping people he had just met and said stepping outside one’s comfort zone is good.
Joanna planned to hike with buddies during the weekend of 2022-06-04 through 2022-06-05, exploring a new trail with a waterfall. Joanna said she was excited about the hike.

The competition was online; Nate enjoyed competing and showing his skills, described the victory as indescribable, and felt proud to earn money doing what he loves. He shared a photo of a television screen showing a trophy and another trophy.

On 2022-07-10, Joanna said a page of her story included dialogue exploring loss, redemption, and forgiveness. She described the story as deep and emotional and said she was excited about it.
On 2022-07-10, Joanna said she had never really tried publishing a book before and that this project might be her first book publication.

On 2022-07-10, Nate encouraged Joanna about publishing her book and said people would recognize her as the same author of the movie she had gotten published and would love the book even more. Joanna thanked Nate and said his belief in her meant a lot.
On 2022-07-10, Nate told Joanna he believed her hard work would pay off, urged her to believe in herself and her talent, and called her incredible. He said he was there for her.
On 2022-07-10, Nate shared a photo showing a person holding a small turtle in a container. The person's identity was not specified.

On 2022-08-14, Joanna told Nate that she had been busy with writing projects and that writing had become a major part of her life. She described her journal as her rock and writing as an escape and a way to express her feelings, turn her thoughts into something good, and find healing through words.
On 2022-08-14, Joanna shared a photo of a notebook covered with many stickers.
On 2022-08-14, Joanna shared a photo of a handwritten letter from a man holding a piece of paper.

During the week of 2022-08-07 to 2022-08-13, someone wrote Joanna a letter after reading her online blog post about a difficult moment in her life. The writer said Joanna's story had brought them comfort. Joanna felt touched and encouraged because her writing had made a difference; she said this impact keeps her writing even on tough days.
On 2022-08-14, Joanna shared a photo of a note written to a person on a piece of paper; the conversation associated it with the letter she received after publishing her blog post.
On 2022-08-14, Nate praised Joanna's writing and said he was glad her words had helped her; he told her she was inspiring and changing lives.
By 2022-08-14, Nate had started teaching people how to make dairy-free desserts. He described sharing his love of dairy-free desserts as fun and rewarding.
On 2022-08-14, Nate shared a photo of a dessert topped with whipped cream and chocolate sauce.
On 2022-08-14, Joanna said she loved Nate's coconut milk ice cream and thought it was very good.

On 2022-08-14, Nate offered Joanna a new recipe for a creamy, rich, dairy-free dessert and said he would send it to her. Joanna accepted and planned to surprise her family with something delicious; Nate encouraged her to bake and asked her to let him know how it went. The specific recipe and dessert were not identified in the conversation.

On 2022-08-21, Nate won an international gaming tournament. On 2022-08-22, he said gaming had brought him success and enabled him to make a living doing something he was passionate about; he was excited and proud that his hard work was paying off.

On 2022-08-22, Nate shared a photo described as a fish tank with a fish inside. Nate called the animals in the tank his “little dudes” and said their tank expansion had made them happy; he described them as calm and peaceful companions who made coming home after a long gaming day better. Joanna responded that they looked adorable and seemed to have more room to swim. The conversation does not clarify the apparent mismatch with Nate’s previously known pet turtles.

On 2022-08-22, Joanna said she had shared her book with her writers group during the previous week and had been very nervous, but received great feedback. Joanna said the feedback made her feel that her hard work was paying off. She shared a photo of a desk with a chair and a computer.

On 2022-08-22, Joanna said she celebrated positive feedback on her writing by making a delicious treat. She shared a photo of two desserts with spoons and a bar of chocolate. Nate also shared a photo of a dessert in a glass on a counter while congratulating Joanna.
For the weekend of 2022-08-27 to 2022-08-28, Nate planned to take time off and relax with his pets. Joanna planned to recharge with a long walk and reading.

On 2022-08-22, Joanna said taking breaks and looking after herself are important for her inspiration and mental health, and that finding balance matters. Nate agreed that balance is key and said self-care helps people be more creative and happier.

On 2022-08-22, Nate asked Joanna for book recommendations, saying he was always looking for something new to read and had many books to choose from. He shared a photo of a bookcase filled with books and a toy car. No recommendation appears in this segment.
On 2022-08-22, Joanna recommended that Nate find a fantasy book series to read, saying fiction series are great for relaxing.

On 2022-08-22, Nate showed Joanna a photo of a stack of books on a wooden table and asked whether that was a good series to read. Joanna approved of the series, and Nate said he would read it and tell her what he thought when he finished. The series title is not stated.

On 2022-08-22, Nate recommended a series to Joanna, showing her a photo of a poster depicting a man falling off a cliff. Nate praised its battles, action scenes, interesting characters, and plot, and said it was one of his favorites. Joanna said it looked awesome and planned to add it to her reading list. The series title is not stated.
On 2022-08-22, Nate and Joanna ended their conversation by wishing each other a good day and saying goodbye.
On 2022-09-05, Nate shared a photo of his two turtles sitting on a rock in a pond and said spending time with them had been a big help, especially recently.

On 2022-09-05, Nate said he had recently performed poorly in a video game tournament despite trying. He felt let down and called it a setback, but was trying to stay positive and viewed it as part of the learning curve.

On 2022-09-05, Joanna shared a photo of a piece of cake with strawberries and chocolate. She said she had revised an old recipe and had been tinkering with that recipe and others for comfort and creative enjoyment.

Joanna is lactose intolerant and is experimenting with dairy-free desserts, using alternatives such as coconut milk or almond milk. She enjoys the challenge of making tasty treats suitable for different diets.

On 2022-09-05, Joanna said she was experimenting with chocolate, raspberry, and coconut flavors and tweaking a dessert recipe to make it tastier and more accessible. She had made dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting and shared a photo of cupcakes on a plate with different toppings.
Joanna has been making a range of desserts suitable for different diets, including cookies, pies, and cakes, and said she would share more recipes with Nate soon.

On 2022-09-05, Nate asked to join Joanna for baking or cooking, saying that those activities bring them together. Joanna welcomed him as a fellow chef in the kitchen and asked him for dairy-free baking tips.
On 2022-09-05, Nate shared a photo of a pile of cookies with sprinkles on a wooden table while asking Joanna if he could join her for baking or cooking.
On September 5, 2022, Nate suggested that Joanna use dairy-free margarine or coconut oil instead of butter and check product labels to make sure ingredients are dairy-free.
On September 5, 2022, Joanna thanked Nate for his baking ideas and shared a photo of a cookie topped with chocolate drizzle and almonds. Joanna said she could not wait to try Nate’s suggestions.
On September 5, 2022, Nate told Joanna she could ask him questions whenever she needed help; Nate said he liked helping.
On September 5, 2022, Joanna said goodbye to Nate and said she would see him soon. Nate said goodbye to Joanna and wished her good luck.

Joanna’s laptop crashed during the week of 2022-09-05 to 2022-09-11, and she lost all her work; she said that as a writer, her laptop was half of her lifeline and losing her progress was a major blow. Nothing could be recovered.
After losing her work in a laptop crash, Joanna got an external drive to back up her writing and said she never wanted to go through that again.
On Monday, 2022-09-12, Nate taught people vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show. He found appearing on the show nerve-wracking but enjoyable, and learned several new recipes.
Joanna congratulated Nate on his cooking show and said she would definitely tune in. She asked which dish from the show was Nate’s favorite; no answer is included in this segment.

On 2022-09-14, Nate said coconut milk ice cream is one of his favorite desserts because it is smooth and creamy with a tropical coconut flavor, and it is dairy-free for people who are lactose intolerant or choose vegan options.
On 2022-09-14, Nate shared a photo of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon on a table, describing it as the coconut milk ice cream he made.

On 2022-09-14, Joanna praised the appearance of Nate's coconut milk ice cream and asked him to share the recipe. Nate agreed to share it and asked her to tell him when she made it; no recipe details were given in this conversation segment.
On Friday, 2022-09-09, Joanna made a delicious dessert with almond milk and said it turned out well. On 2022-09-14, she said dairy-free desserts are a must for her.
On 2022-09-14, Nate said he also enjoys dairy-free chocolate mousse, which he described as super creamy and tasting like conventional mousse.
On 2022-09-14, Joanna said her favorite dairy-free treat is chocolate raspberry tart made with an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache, and fresh raspberries.
On 2022-09-14, Joanna shared a photo of a chocolate tart topped with raspberries. Nate said it looked amazing and that he wanted to try baking it.

On 2022-09-14, Nate shared a photo of a piece of chocolate cake with raspberries on a plate while asking Joanna what other treats she liked making. Joanna also shared a photo of a piece of chocolate cake with raspberries on a plate and described it as her moist, delicious dairy-free chocolate cake with a just-right sweetness.
Joanna makes her dairy-free chocolate cake with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate, and raspberries. She said it is her favorite cake for birthdays and special days. Nate said he wanted to try it.

On 2022-09-14, Joanna shared another dessert recipe described as a creamy dessert made with blueberries, coconut milk, and a gluten-free crust. The shared photo showed a piece of cake topped with walnuts; the conversation did not clarify the apparent difference between the recipe description and photo.
Nate said Joanna's blueberry and coconut milk dessert looked amazing and that he would try it. Joanna invited him to let her know if he tried it; they ended the conversation warmly.

On 2022-10-05, Joanna tried her newest dairy-free recipe, a raspberry tart shown on a white plate in a shared photo. Joanna said her family loved it and she enjoys mixing and matching flavors and trying new recipes.
During the week before 2022-10-06, Nate won a major video game tournament and earned a substantial amount of money. Nate shared a photo of a trophy and game controller on a table.

After winning the tournament, Nate saved some of his prize money but had no particular plans for it. He said he was already content and liked having extra money available; it helped him feel less stressed and enjoy movies and games.

Nate watched the film Little Women recently and thought it was great, praising the acting and captivating story. Joanna had recommended the film to Nate earlier; Joanna had also watched it and said its themes of sisterhood, love, and pursuing dreams resonated with her.
During the week before 2022-10-06, Joanna finished writing her book after many late nights and edits. Joanna said she was proud of finishing and looked forward to what would happen next.

On 2022-10-06, Nate congratulated Joanna on completing her book, told her he was proud of her and would always support her. Joanna thanked Nate and said his support meant a lot and helped her keep pursuing her goals. Nate said encouragement had helped him in his gaming career and he wanted to share that support.

On 2022-10-06, Nate made Joanna an encouraging whiteboard drawing, shown in a shared photo; the board had arrows and words, though the words were not specified. Nate said Joanna could look at it when she needed encouragement and described her life path as inspirational. He also shared a photo of a young boy drawing on a whiteboard; the boy's identity and connection to Nate or Joanna were not stated.
On 2022-10-06, Joanna finished a cute bookmark for a woman in her writing club. The shared photo showed a bookmark with a plant on top.
Joanna loves DIY projects, and said that the woman in her writing club who was receiving the bookmark also loves DIYs.
Nate complimented Joanna's bookmark and said he was sure its recipient would love it. Nate asked Joanna to let him know how it went; Joanna agreed before saying goodbye.

On Friday, 2022-10-07, Nate went to a game convention and met people outside his usual social circle. He found meeting new people somewhat overwhelming, but the experience reminded him of the good times gaming can bring. A shared photo showed a man standing in front of a table of board games.
Joanna encouraged Nate to step outside his comfort zone, saying that meeting new people can be overwhelming but rewarding and that exploring new things can be worthwhile.

At the convention, Nate made friends who shared his love of games and planned a gaming session with them. A shared photo showed two people dressed in costumes posing together; the conversation did not identify them.

At the convention, Nate joined people playing a board game he loves, and they hit it off over their shared interests. They played Catan, which Nate described as a strategy game involving building settlements and trading resources. A shared photo showed a board game with a blue board and a yellow board.

Nate said Catan can be either competitive or chill; his group played competitively while still having fun. Joanna said competitive games can be difficult when players get upset about every move, and was glad Nate's group stayed relaxed.
Nate said playing games is an escape from life's struggles and that he generally does not get excessively competitive. He found that the people he met at the convention had a similar attitude.
Joanna was glad Nate had found a fun way to escape and de-stress, and encouraged him to keep doing what makes him happy.

Nate suggested Joanna consider going to a writing convention sometime, saying his convention experience was unforgettable. Joanna wondered whether writing conventions exist and said she would look into the idea because it could be fun.
On the evening of 2022-10-09, Nate said he was mostly relaxing at home. Playing video games and watching movies help him unwind. A shared photo showed a bookcase filled with DVDs and movies.
Joanna asked Nate what his favorite game or movie was among the ones he had seen recently; the conversation segment ends before he answers.
On 2022-10-09, Nate said he had recently watched the twist-filled movie “Inception” and had been playing “Cyberpunk 2077” nonstop, enjoying its futuristic setting and gameplay.

On 2022-10-09, Joanna said she had recently watched an unnamed classic movie with a gripping story and great acting. She shared a photo of a framed movie poster with a signed picture; the movie’s title was not specified.
On 2022-10-09, Joanna rated the classic movie she had watched around 9 or 10 out of 10 and said movies can transport viewers and evoke many emotions.
Nate enjoys movies because they take him to new worlds, fill him with emotions, and help him relax after a day.
Joanna enjoys watching movies at home on a comfortable couch with a good blanket, which makes her feel at peace. She considers movies an escape that can evoke feelings beyond everyday life.
On 2022-10-09, Joanna shared a photo of a living room with a TV and candles while discussing a cozy movie-watching setup.

On 2022-10-09, Joanna advised Nate to make his living room more comfortable with a fluffy couch large enough for multiple people to lie down on, a somewhat heavy blanket, and dimmable lights. She shared a photo of a poster showing a man and a woman sitting on a bench; the poster’s subject or title was not identified.
Joanna gets invested in small home-related details and feels that little comforts make life much nicer.
On October 9, 2022, Nate thanked Joanna for a tip and said he would see her later; Joanna replied, “See ya Nate!”
On 2022-10-21, Joanna told Nate that she had been revising and perfecting the recipe she had made for her family, and that it had turned out very tasty.

On 2022-10-21, Nate said he was stressed about his progress in a video game tournament because he faced tough competitors. He said his two turtles cheered him up, and that watching them slowly walk around made him happy.

Joanna has a stuffed-animal dog that Nate gave her. Joanna named the toy Tilly after a dog she used to have in Michigan. Joanna said she became allergic and her family had to give away the real dog. The name reminds Joanna of when she could hold and squeeze animals without an allergic reaction. Tilly stays with Joanna while she writes, helps her focus, and brings her joy.
On 2022-10-21, Joanna shared a photo showing a cat lying on the floor in a room.
On 2022-10-21, Nate said he had been practicing for his next video game tournament.

By 2022-10-21, Joanna had received another rejection from a production company for a project she had sent to a film contest. She found the setback hard but said she would keep working and moving forward rather than let it slow her down.

On 2022-10-21, Nate encouraged Joanna after her production-company rejection, telling her that rejections did not define her and that she would find the right opportunity. Joanna said his encouragement meant a lot and that she would keep pushing forward and believing in herself. Nate said he respected her resilience and reminded her that people were cheering her on.

On 2022-10-23, one of Joanna’s movie scripts that she contributed to was shown on the big screen for the first time. Joanna described the experience as surreal and satisfying after a long wait, and said it was the third time one of her script contributions had been shown on the big screen.
records.topic: Movie script shown on the big screen

records.text: Joanna said her favorite part of seeing her script on screen was watching the characters she had worked hard on come alive, as though they had jumped off the page and become real.
records.topic: Movie script shown on the big screen

records.text: Joanna draws visuals of her characters to help bring them alive in her mind and write them better. She finds character ideas in people she knows, things she has seen, and her imagination, and enjoys seeing ideas take shape as people with their own wants, worries, and wishes.
Joanna shared a photo of a drawing book containing character drawings. She declined Nate’s request to explain the character on the left, telling him he would have to watch the movie to find out.
Joanna shared a photo of a box of cards with a quote on it. Nate shared photos of himself holding a videogame controller and of a box containing a controller.
Nate said he was already planning to watch Joanna’s movie, and their conversation about her work made him want to watch it even more.

Photos shared on 2022-10-25 also included Joanna’s photo of a box of quote cards and Nate holding a videogame controller and a box containing a controller.
On 2022-10-25, Nate said he had been bored and took his two turtles for a walk. Nate shared a photo showing two turtles sitting on a log in a pond.
On 2022-10-25, Nate said his two turtles seemed tired after walking and were relaxing in their tank. Alongside this, Nate shared a photo showing a dog lying on a rock at a zoo.
On 2022-10-25, Joanna asked what Nate's turtles eat and shared a photo of a spoonful of ice cream with chocolate sauce.
Nate's two turtles eat a varied diet of vegetables, fruits, and insects. Nate shared a photo of lettuce and other greens when describing their diet.
Nate especially enjoys watching his two turtles eat fruit because they get excited, and he finds their enthusiasm cute. Nate shared a photo showing strawberries and a turtle on a table.
Nate likes holding his turtles and finds it fun to watch them enjoy their favorite snacks. Nate shared a photo of a person holding a small turtle in one hand.

Nate says his two turtles have distinct personalities: one is more adventurous and the other more reserved. Nate finds this distinction cute, says the turtles bring him joy and are great companions, and says he has liked turtles since he was a boy and knows a lot about them.

On 2022-10-25, Joanna said she had not realized turtles could be so interesting until she met Nate's turtles. Joanna asked Nate to keep her updated about the turtles and said she had enjoyed chatting.
On 2022-10-25, Joanna shared a photo of a rock formation with a person standing beside it while asking Nate about his turtles' personalities.
On 2022-10-25, Nate said goodbye to Joanna, telling her, “See you later, Joanna!”
On 2022-11-04, Joanna told Nate that she had set up meetings with movie producers and felt her dreams were coming true.

Joanna said her meetings with movie producers went really well. She felt confident discussing her script and vision; the producers seemed interested and excited, and they loved the story's elements of self-discovery. Joanna felt validated to be taken seriously and hopeful and inspired about the future.

Nate congratulated Joanna on her successful producer meetings, said he was proud of her, and compared the thrill of receiving recognition for hard work to winning a video game tournament. Nate shared a photo of a television screen showing a game being played.

Joanna said writing is not always easy, but moments like her successful producer meetings make her appreciate writing and feel thankful for opportunities. She said that during the week before 2022-11-04, she found old notebooks containing her early writings and enjoyed seeing how far she had come. Joanna shared a photo of a notebook with a list of things to write.
Nate shared a photo of a turtle lying on a bed of rocks and gravel, then asked Joanna whether a favorite piece from her early writings stood out to her.

On 2022-11-04, Joanna recalled a story she remembered from when she was 10: it was about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway. Joanna said stories about courage and taking risks may have inspired her even then, and that these themes remain part of her writing.
On 2022-11-04, Joanna said turtles make her think of strength and perseverance and motivate her in tough times.
On 2022-11-04, Nate shared a photo of a turtle lying on a bed of rocks and gravel. Nate said he loves turtles and finds their resilience inspiring.
On 2022-11-04, Joanna said that, apart from attending meetings, she was working on a project that was challenging but fulfilling. Joanna said her meetings were exciting.
On 2022-11-04, Nate said he had been helping friends reset their high scores at an international tournament and was enjoying it. Nate said using his skills to make a difference felt good.

On 2022-11-04, Nate invited Joanna to come over and try a bowl of ice cream he had made the previous day. Nate shared a photo of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it; he did not specify its ingredients.
On 2022-11-04, Nate shared a photo of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it. Nate said he had made the ice cream with coconut milk, making it lactose-free.
Joanna said she would come over to Nate’s place on 2022-11-05, if that was fine with Nate.
On 2022-11-04, Nate agreed that Joanna could join him, saying he was free then. Joanna planned to bring some of her recipes so they could share desserts together.
Nate said he had wanted to try Joanna’s chocolate raspberry cake for a while and was excited about sharing desserts with her.
Joanna and Nate planned to see each other on November 5, 2022; they confirmed the plan on November 4, 2022.
On 2022-11-05, Nate reached the final of a major Valorant tournament and won, feeling intensely happy when he saw his name as champion. Nate said tournaments bring out strong emotions in him.
On 2022-11-04, Joanna finished a presentation for producers. She said the work was tough but that the presentation was looking good.
On 2022-11-07, Joanna shared a photo of a notebook with a handwritten letter on it.
As of 2022-11-07, Nate was preparing for other tournaments, was very busy, and was enjoying himself.
On November 7, 2022, Joanna told Nate she was writing another movie script, a love story with many challenges. She said the idea came from a dream and hoped to get the script onto the big screen.
Joanna said writing has always been her passion and that creating stories and watching them come alive gives her happiness and fulfillment.

Joanna said she had submitted a few more movie scripts during the week of October 31 to November 6, 2022, and was hoping to hear back. She expected that a few might be rejected but promised Nate she would not give up.
Nate encouraged Joanna, saying he believed at least one of her submitted scripts would make it to the screen and become her third published movie.
On November 7, 2022, Nate shared a photo of a book with a black border and white title; the book's title and contents were not specified.
Nate shared a photo of a turtle lying on rocks and gravel. He said his two turtles bring joy to his life, and that watching them is calming and fascinating; he has grown fond of them.

Nate said he had recently upgraded his home equipment. He shared photos showing a desk with a computer monitor and keyboard, a desk with two monitors and a laptop, and a pair of headphones with a video game controller.

Nate uses his home computer setup to practice and compete in gaming, and sometimes to play games with friends. He described the setup as a haven where he can escape into the virtual world and said it is important for his career and beating competitors.

Nate shared photos of a book with a black border and white title and a turtle on rocks and gravel.

On November 7, 2022, Nate said he was enjoying the fantasy role-playing game “Xeonoblade Chronicles” (apparently Xenoblade Chronicles), a Nintendo game series. He had wanted to play it because his friends played and recommended it. Nate shared a photo of two Nintendo game covers featuring a group of people.

Joanna asked Nate what prompted him to start playing the game and whether it was a Japanese game series. Nate confirmed that it was Japanese and said he was a big fan of Nintendo games. Nate also shared a photo of a woman in a costume holding a glass.

Joanna said that a recommendation from a friend feels especially satisfying when it fits one’s taste. Nate agreed and said he usually enjoys Joanna’s movie recommendations more than movies he chooses at random.

On November 7, 2022, Joanna said she had finished the introduction to her next movie script and decided to include a handwritten letter from a young man at the beginning. Joanna shared a photo of the letter. Nate said it was awesome and asked whether it reminded Joanna of her childhood.

Joanna said the handwritten letter in her movie script was written by her brother, who used to make her cute notes when they were children. Seeing the letter brought back sweet childhood memories for Joanna.

Joanna said childhood memories take people back to simpler times, while creating new memories as they grow up is also worthwhile. Joanna shared a photo of two little girls in pink dresses standing in front of a castle.

Nate said he had a special day taking his pets to the park; seeing the pets amazed and happy made the day memorable. Nate said he treasures his memories and values mixing new experiences with old ones. The pets are Nate’s two turtles, according to the existing conversation context.

Joanna said she had started writing down some of her favorite memories and shared a photo of someone holding a notebook with a list in it. Nate praised Joanna’s ideas and said he should write down things his animals like, as well as favorite memories.
Nate said he would start writing down favorite memories, including memories with Joanna. Joanna encouraged him, saying that looking back on fond memories is a blessing.
Joanna and Nate agreed to keep making great memories, supporting each other, and pursuing their dreams. Joanna shared a photo of two women sitting on a bed and laughing.

On 2022-11-09, Nate said his game tournament had been pushed back, so he tried cooking and made homemade coconut ice cream. He shared a photo showing a person scooping ice cream into a pan and said sprinkles had changed its color.
On 2022-11-09, Nate said his most recent game tournament had been tough and he had not made the finals. He remained optimistic and said he would try again next time.

On 2022-11-09, Nate was considering joining a new gaming team after his next tournament. He had received several offers, had not decided which team to choose, and viewed a team switch as a major step and a chance for a shake-up.

On 2022-11-08, Joanna pitched a script to producers after working hard on it and creating a plan to get it made into a movie. The producers liked the pitch, which gave Joanna a significant confidence boost. Nate congratulated Joanna and said he was proud of her.

On 2022-11-09, Joanna said she felt she could not stop writing. She shared a photo of a pen and notebook on a table with a book, and said she was developing a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town as a creative outlet.

On 2022-11-09, Nate said he was starting to create gaming content for YouTube during periods without tournaments. He liked gaming videos and hoped to entertain viewers, share his love of games, and connect with other gaming fans. Nate shared a photo of a desk with a computer, headphones, and a microphone.
On 2022-11-09, Joanna encouraged Nate about his plans to join a gaming team and create gaming videos. Joanna said Nate's video-making idea was cool and expressed confidence that he would do well.
